sign_flip_placebo.construction: Book C's eligible set and Book C's overhang series, cut at the BOTTOM tercile instead of the top and ranked most-negative-first. Nothing else moves: same k, same monthly engine, same cost ruler, same twin.
sign_flip_placebo.long_short_note: the literature's own shape, REPORTED. Frazzini reports ~0 for it. It decides nothing here because its comparator is a different universe (bad-news names) and the book's registered comparator is the unconditioned reaction book.
sign_flip_placebo.reading: the placebo does not pay: -0.000266/month vs the unconditioned book at NW lag-2 t -0.1292 over 359 blocks. §5 fires on a placebo that pays (positive AND |t| >= 2.0); a placebo indistinguishable from 0 is what the book needs and is not by itself evidence FOR the book.

momentum_orthogonalisation.registered_as: TRIAL-DRAFT-C §1 quotes Grinblatt-Han: with overhang on the right-hand side, intermediate-horizon momentum DISAPPEARS. §5 makes its survival a FAILED_VARIANT trigger.
momentum_orthogonalisation.construction: mom_12_1 (eleven months, skipping the most recent) and the book's own overhang, standardised in each month's cross-section, each regressed on the other, and the re-standardised residual's payoff priced against NEXT month's return. Both directions are reported.

fama_macbeth.units: every slope is the next month's return per ONE cross-sectional sd of the regressor, and every residual is re-standardised so the four legs share that ruler

momentum_orthogonalisation.why: with overhang on the right-hand side momentum's payoff carries t 0.1174 against the |t| >= 2.0 line (raw, before orthogonalisation: t 0.1525); overhang's own residual payoff carries t 0.8595. Grinblatt-Han's claim is that momentum DISAPPEARS here; TRIAL-DRAFT-C §5 closes the book as FAILED_VARIANT if it does not.

decision_rule: TRIAL-DRAFT-C §5. FAILED_VARIANT if the placebo also pays OR momentum survives orthogonalisation — either clause alone, whatever the primary metric did. CONDITIONAL stands only if BOTH falsifiers pass. The primary metric it is read against is the REGISTERED construction's, not run 1's.
